# Indonesian question explanations — batch 003 — 2026-10-14

## Scope

Translated the next 100 source-ordered Indonesian question explanations. The batch covers present perfect continuous, future continuous, passive voice, conditionals, relative clauses, gerunds/infinitives, and conjunction versus preposition choices.

Every explanation was authored from its English explanation in `content/en/questions.json`. Question stems, options, answers, stable IDs, and taught English forms remain unchanged.
